sentence: 廉颇闻之，肉袒负荆，因宾客至蔺相如门谢罪。
source: 廉颇蔺相如列传（course_cards_v2 第 458 行）
issue_type: 多字词未整体处理 + 译文夹带未译中文
current_english: Hearing these words, Lian Po took off his coat, 露出上身, carried a wicker stick, and led by a guest, came to Lin Xiangru's door to apologize.
suggested_english: Hearing this, Lian Po bared his shoulders and back, carried bramble thorns on his back, and led by one of his retainers came to Lin Xiangru's gate to beg pardon.
reason: ① 英文句中直接残留中文「露出上身」，属硬性缺陷；② 「肉袒」是整体词（脱去上衣、露出肩背），译作 took off his coat 只译出「脱衣」一半，丢了「袒（裸露）」；③ 「负荆」的荆是荆条/荆棘，用于受鞭打示罚，wicker stick（柳条杖）既非荆条也丢掉了「背负请罚」的礼俗含义。
applied_english: Hearing this, Lian Po bared his shoulders and back, carried bramble thorns on his back, and led by one of his retainers came to Lin Xiangru's gate to beg pardon.

source: 廉颇蔺相如列传（第 460 行）
issue_type: 多字词拆字直译、整体义偏移
current_english: In the end they became friends again, neck-cutting friends.
suggested_english: In the end they were reconciled and became friends sworn to die for each other.
reason: 「刎颈之交」是固定成语，指「同生共死、可为之刎颈的朋友」，整体义是『生死之交』。译作 neck-cutting friends 是逐字直译（刎+颈+之+交），英文读者只会理解为「割脖子的朋友」，既不通也无典故感。应整体译为 sworn friends unto death / friends ready to die for each other。
applied_english: In the end they were reconciled and became friends sworn to die for each other.

sentence: 臣知欺大王之罪当诛，臣请就汤镬，唯大王与群臣孰计议之。
source: 廉颇蔺相如列传（第 413 行）
issue_type: 多字词整体义偏移（刑名误译）
current_english: I know that deceiving the king should be punished by death. I am willing to be boiled in oil, but I only hope that Your Majesty and your ministers will consider this matter carefully.
suggested_english: I know that deceiving Your Majesty deserves death; I beg to be thrown into the boiling cauldron. I only hope that Your Majesty and the ministers will deliberate on this carefully.
reason: 「汤镬」是古代酷刑名：汤＝滚水，镬＝无足大鼎，即『投入滚水大鼎烹死』。译作 boiled in oil 把「汤（水）」误作「油」，刑名整体偏移；且 就汤镬＝就刑，be willing to be boiled 弱化了「请受此刑」的决绝语气。
applied_english: I know that deceiving Your Majesty deserves death; I beg to be thrown into the boiling cauldron. I only hope that Your Majesty and the ministers will deliberate on this carefully.

sentence: 君不如肉袒伏斧质请罪，则幸得脱矣。
source: 廉颇蔺相如列传（第 377 行）
issue_type: 多字词整体义偏移（刑具误译 + 动词误译）
current_english: I suggest you take off your coat, bare your shoulders and back, and kowtow on the axe blade to ask the Great King for punishment. Maybe you will be pardoned by luck."
suggested_english: You had better bare your shoulders and back, lie face down on the executioner's block, and beg for punishment; you may then be pardoned by good fortune.
reason: 「斧质」是刑具整体：斧＝刑刀，质（锧）＝受刑时伏卧的砧板。译作 the axe blade 只取「刀刃」，丢掉「砧板」；「伏」是伏卧其上，译作 kowtow（叩头）把动作换成跪拜礼，与受刑场景不符。
applied_english: You had better bare your shoulders and back, lie face down on the executioner's block and beg for punishment; you may then be pardoned by good fortune.

term: 长史（并及尚书、侍中、参军）
sentence: 侍中、尚书、长史、参军，此悉贞良死节之臣，愿陛下亲之信之，则汉室之隆，可计日而待也。
current_english: Palace attendants, government officials, historiographers, and staff officers, these are all loyal and honest ministers who are ready to die for their country, I hope that you will get close to them, trust them, then the rise of the Han dynasty will be just around the corner.
suggested_english: Palace Attendants, Imperial Secretaries, Chief Secretaries and Staff Officers—all these are loyal and upright ministers who would die for principle. I hope Your Majesty will draw close to them and trust them; then the revival of the Han house may be counted on by the day.
reason: 四个官名被按字面拆解：长史译作 historiographers（史官）属误译——长史是丞相/将军府属官之首，掌文书、总务，应作 Chief Secretary；尚书译作 government officials 泛化失指（应为 Imperial Secretary）；参军作 staff officers 尚可，侍中作 Palace Attendants 可。官名是文化专名，须整体对应而非逐字直译。
applied_english: Palace Attendants, Imperial Secretaries, Chief Secretaries and Staff Officers—all these are loyal and upright ministers who would die for principle. I hope Your Majesty will draw close to them and trust them; then the rise of the Han house may be counted on by the day.

sentence: 至于斟酌损益，进尽忠言，则攸之、祎、允之任也。
current_english: As for handling political affairs, grasping the measure, and offering loyal advice, it is the responsibility of Guo Youzhi, Fei, and Dong Yun.
suggested_english: As for weighing measures and interests and tendering wholehearted loyal advice, that is the duty of Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi and Dong Yun.
reason: 原文「攸之、祎、允」为三人省称：郭攸之、费祎、董允。译文把「祎」直接音译成 Fei，只留姓不留名，读者会误以为是另一位「费」姓者；应补全为 Fei Yi。
applied_english: As for weighing measures and interests and tendering wholehearted loyal advice, that is the duty of Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi and Dong Yun.

sentence: 秦孝公据崤函之固，拥雍州之地，君臣固守以窥周室，有席卷天下，包举宇内，囊括四海之意，并吞八荒之心。 ／ 然后以六合为家，崤函为宫；
issue_type: 地名整体处理失当（音译混淆）
current_english: Duke Xiao of Qin, holding the fastness of Xiao and Han and possessing the land of Yongzhou, with ruler and ministers firmly guarding and eyeing the Zhou court, cherished the ambition to sweep up the world, wrap up the whole realm, gather in the four seas, and swallow the eight wilds. ／ then it made the Six Directions its home and Xiao-Han its palace;
suggested_english: …holding the fastness of Mount Xiao and the Hangu Pass and possessing the land of Yongzhou… ／ then it made the whole world its home and Mount Xiao and the Hangu Pass its palace;
reason: 「崤函」是「崤山＋函谷关」的并称专名。译文作 Xiao and Han / Xiao-Han，把「函（谷关）」译成 Han，与「韩国」「汉朝」完全混同；且两处译法不一致（and / 连字符）。应统一为 Mount Xiao and the Hangu Pass。
applied_english: Duke Xiao of Qin, holding the fastness of Mount Xiao and the Hangu Pass and possessing the land of Yongzhou, with ruler and ministers firmly guarding it and eyeing the Zhou royal house, cherished the ambition to sweep up the world, wrap up the whole realm, gather in the four seas and swallow the eight wilds.
then it made the Six Directions its home and Mount Xiao and the Hangu Pass its palace;

sentence: 至于负者歌于途，行者休于树，前者呼，后者应，伛偻提携，往来而不绝者，滁人游也。
current_english: Moreover, carriers singing on the road, travellers resting under trees, those in front calling and those behind answering, old bent folk leading children by the hand, coming and going without cease—that is the people of Chu on their excursions.
suggested_english: …coming and going without cease—these are the people of Chuzhou out enjoying the hills.
reason: 「滁人」指滁州百姓。译作 the people of Chu 会被读成「楚国人/楚地人」，与春秋战国之「楚」混淆；欧阳修贬所是滁州（今安徽滁州），应作 Chuzhou。

sentence: 然侍卫之臣不懈于内，忠志之士忘身于外者，盖追先帝之殊遇，欲报之于陛下也。
current_english: However, the close officials around him can still diligently and unremittingly fulfill their duties in the DPRK; the loyal and brave generals fought desperately on the battlefield, sacrificing their lives, because they remembered the kindness of the late emperor and wanted to repay Your Majesty with all their strength.
suggested_english: Yet the guards and attendants within the palace are untiring in their duties, and the loyal and public-spirited men outside risk their lives on the battlefield, because they recall the late Emperor's exceptional treatment of them and wish to repay it to Your Majesty.
reason: 「不懈于内」的「内」指宫中、朝内，译文作 in the DPRK（朝鲜民主主义人民共和国），是缩写误配造成的严重错误，必须改为 within the palace / at court。
applied_english: Yet the guards and attendants within the palace are untiring in their duty, and loyal and high-minded men outside risk their lives, because they recall the late Emperor's exceptional favour and wish to repay it to Your Majesty.

sentence: 然侍卫之臣不懈于内，忠志之士忘身于外者，盖追先帝之殊遇，欲报之于陛下也。
current_english: However, the close officials around him can still diligently and unremittingly fulfill their duties in the DPRK; the loyal and brave generals fought desperately on the battlefield, sacrificing their lives, because they remembered the kindness of the late emperor and wanted to repay Your Majesty with all their strength.
suggested_english: …the loyal and high-minded men outside risk their lives…
reason: 「士」在此泛指有志节的臣民/将士，译文作 generals（将领）把范围窄化为武将；「忠志」是「忠诚有志节」，译作 loyal and brave（忠勇）偏移为「勇敢」。另「忘身于外」的「于外」指在外（战场/朝外），译文补作 on the battlefield 属增译，可保留但需与「士」的宽泛所指协调。
applied_english: Yet the guards and attendants within the palace are untiring in their duty, and loyal and high-minded men outside risk their lives, because they recall the late Emperor's exceptional favour and wish to repay it to Your Majesty.

sentence: 先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也。
current_english: The great cause of the first emperor was not half completed and died in the middle. Now the world is divided into three countries, the population of Yizhou is scarce, this is indeed a time of national crisis.
suggested_english: The late Emperor had not half accomplished his great enterprise when he died on the way. Now the realm is divided into three, and Yizhou is worn out and exhausted—this is truly a moment of crisis, of survival or ruin.
reason: 「创业未半而中道崩殂」的主语是「先帝」，「崩殂」是天子死亡的专称。译文把主语接成了 The great cause…and died in the middle，字面上成了「大业死了」，主谓错配；「中道」是「中途/半路」，作 in the middle 也与「功业未半」重复含混。
applied_english: The late Emperor had not half accomplished his great enterprise when he died on the way. Now the realm is divided into three, and Yizhou is worn out and exhausted—this is truly the hour of crisis, of survival or ruin.

sentence: 对曰：“忠之属也，可以一战。
issue_type: 古今异义 + 虚词「以」功能丢失
current_english: Cao Qufu replied, "This is only doing one's duty, and one can fight."
suggested_english: "This shows that he does his duty by the people," replied Cao Gui. "You may fight on the strength of this."
reason: 「可以」在此是两个词：可（可以）＋以（凭借），「可以一战」＝「可以凭借（这一点）打一仗」。译文作 and one can fight，把「以」的凭借义整个丢掉，读者看不出「凭什么是这一条」。另「忠之属也」是判断句「（这）属于忠这一类」，「属」是「类」，译作 only doing one's duty 既丢了判断语气，又用 only 添加了原文没有的限定义。

sentence: 呼尔而与之，行道之人弗受；
current_english: If given with insulting shouts, even a beggar on the road will not accept;
suggested_english: If you shout at him to take it, even a passer-by will not accept it;
reason: 「行道之人」是「走在路上的人、过路的人」，与下句「蹴尔而与之，乞人不屑也」的「乞人（乞丐）」是两个不同主体。译文作 a beggar on the road，把下一句的「乞人」提前挪用，导致两句主体重复、原文「过路人尚且不受 / 乞丐也不屑」的递进消失。

sentence: 富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈。此之谓大丈夫。
issue_type: 词类活用（使动）未体现 + 实词义偏移
current_english: When rich and powerful, one should not be excessive; when poor and humble, one's will should not waver or change. Only those who face formidable forces without yielding can be called great men!
suggested_english: Riches and honours cannot corrupt him, poverty and low station cannot shake him, power and force cannot bend him—such a one is called a great man.
reason: 「富贵不能淫」是使动用法：淫＝惑乱、使……迷惑（心志），即「富贵不能使他的心志惑乱」。译文作 one should not be excessive，把「淫」理解成「过分」，既丢了使动，也把客观陈述（外界不能动摇他）改成了主观劝诫（人不该过分），三句并列的「不能＋使动」结构完全瓦解；后两句用 one's will should not waver 同样是劝诫语气，与「此之谓大丈夫」的定义句不接。

sentence: 既加冠，益慕圣贤之道，又患无硕师名人与游，尝趋百里外，从乡之先达执经叩问。
source: 送东阳马生序（第 627 行）
issue_type: 句级对齐失效（整段译文复用）
current_english: In my youth I was already fond of learning. My family was poor and could not obtain books to read, so I often borrowed from families with collections, copied them out by hand, and counted the days to return them on time. In bitter cold the ink froze solid in the inkstone and my fingers could neither bend nor stretch, yet I did not slacken. When the copying was done I hurried to return the books, never daring to exceed the agreed term by a hair. That is why most people were willing to lend me books, and so I was able to read widely. After coming of age I admired the way of the sages all the more, yet worried that I had no profound masters or famous men to keep company with. I once hurried a hundred li to question a learned elder of my home region, clasping the classics. The elder was of high renown; his disciples filled his room, and he never softened his words or countenance the slightest degree. I stood in attendance, raised doubts and questioned principles, bending down with ears intent; when I met his rebukes my manner grew more respectful, my courtesy more scrupulous, not daring to utter a word in reply; when he grew pleased I would ask again. Thus, dull as I was, I in the end gained real instruction.
suggested_english: After I came of age I admired the way of the sages all the more, yet worried that I had no learned masters or famous men to associate with; I once hurried a hundred li to seek out a venerable elder of my district, clasping the classics to ask his instruction.
reason: 该句 english 字段装的是整段 9 句的译文（从 In my youth I was already fond of learning 起），与本句「既加冠，益慕圣贤之道……」无法句级对应；陈情表、送东阳马生序两篇共 171 句均如此。作为单句对照材料不可用，须按句切分（上列即本句应独立的译文）。
